component.name: Portal 2 Monitor Maker
component.summary: A small tool for creating custom monitor models for Portal 2 modding

description.p: Portal 2 Monitor Maker is a small tool that allows quick creation of custom monitor models to be used in Portal 2 mapping.
You can import your images, select relevant options and export without the hassle of decompiling Valve's model formats.
The graphical effects found on the original monitors are present with added customizability.

screenshot.caption: Main application window showing all of the customizability options
